outcomes: Identify the different styles of scenic paint techniques used in the theater and define commonly used terminology of the theater, especially as it relates to scenic painting.
Demonstrate the basic techniques used in planning and painting scenery for the stage.

rows.title: Beginning Musical Theatre II
rows.title_printed: Course Outline: Riverside Community College District
rows.heading: Student Learning Outcomes
rows.lead: Upon successful completion of the course, students should be able to demonstrate the following skills:
outcomes: Demonstrate appearance, personality, character, focus, pitch, clarity, diction, projection and final beat.
Demonstrate professionalism, express emotions and connections of and with characters.
Demonstrate ability to believably commit to charactactorization within specific traditional musical theatre styles.

rows.title: Dramatic Literature-Script Analysis
rows.title_printed: Course Outline: Riverside Community College District
rows.heading: Student Learning Outcomes
rows.lead: Upon successful completion of the course, students should be able to demonstrate the following skills:
outcomes: Recognize and identify the distinctive features of the major genres, styles, movements, and playwrights of dramatic literature; ancient Greek to present day.
Develop an appreciation for dramatic texts and specific play scripts as unique contributions to and reflection of culture.

rows.title: Pipe Fitting for the Trades
rows.title_printed: Course Outline: Riverside Community College District
rows.heading: Student Learning Outcomes
rows.lead: Upon successful completion of the course, students should be able to demonstrate the following skills:
outcomes: Identify the take-off difference between a long and short radius 90 degree elbow.
Properly calculate the materials needed for a 45 degree offset, with given parameters.

rows.title: Gas Metal Arc Welding
rows.title_printed: Course Outline: Riverside Community College District
rows.heading: Student Learning Outcomes
rows.lead: Upon successful completion of the course, students should be able to demonstrate the following skills:
outcomes: Demonstrate the ability to set-up and shutdown GMAW equipment and accessories as designated.
Identify proper technique for a given GMAW position.
Recognize welding electrodes that apply to the GMAW process.

rows.title: Introduction to Gas Tungsten Arc Welding
rows.title_printed: Course Outline: Riverside Community College District
rows.heading: Student Learning Outcomes
rows.lead: Upon successful completion of the course, students should be able to demonstrate the following skills:
outcomes: Appraise the different types of Tungsten used in Gas Tungsten Arc Welding and their uses.
Explain the proper set up of Gas Tungsten Arc Welding equipment.
Analyze the different welding currents/polarities used in Gas Tungsten Arc Welding.
Interpret and apply appropriate safety procedures in Gas Tungsten Arc Welding.
